scope: Phase 0e remediation and controlled experiments; architecture is not approved by these tests

pulse_2d_projection_only.scope: actual 2D RBSN and patch basis; exact linear modal evolution. Projection error only, no multirate, damage or contact

pulse_actual_coupler.scope: actual legacy E/R coupler; auto-promotion remains enabled and must be checked in mean_active

pulse_1d_control.scope: linear 1D finite-chain CMS control; not evidence of fracture correctness or GPU speed

numeric3d.scope: linear 3D RBSN, consistent full inertia; no 3D damage/contact. Q30 LDL uses i128 products/divisions as CPU oracle; not a WGSL performance claim

gpu.scope: single Apple GPU; existing 3D kernels, not the adaptive engine

limits: No nonlinear fracture run with an accepted new dynamic far-field port yet.
Elastic controls do not validate a material law or certify crack-path accuracy.
Single desktop Apple GPU, 991 cells, existing kernels; not mobile performance or cross-vendor proof.
3D probe is linear elastic only. Integer LDL is a CPU wide-arithmetic oracle, not a GPU solver.
A saturated collapse cannot discriminate fracture fidelity by total dissipation.
CPU work is an estimate. Mean work gains do not impose a worst-frame bound.
